title: Asset label = year make model plus the most specific identifier: Unit, then plate, then last 8 of VIN
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission; ability to edit assets for seeding.
preconditions: 1. One customer has four ZZAUTOTEST assets with invoices in range: (a) one with a unit number, (b) one with a plate but no unit, (c) one with only a VIN of 8+ characters, (d) one with only a VIN shorter than 8 characters.
steps: 1. Expand the customer and read each asset row's label.
expected: 1. Every label starts with the vehicle's year, make, and model.
4. Asset (c) adds " · VIN …" followed by the last 8 characters of the VIN.
5. Asset (d) shows the whole VIN after " · VIN …" (shorter than 8).
6. An asset with none of unit/plate/VIN gets no suffix at all.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
notes: The " · " separator and "VIN …" prefix are quoted from the spec — VIU-confirm the exact rendered punctuation.
